_comment: AlertClassifier config — routes by title string first, cat only as secondary corroboration (see §4 of spec: cat mapping is unstable over time, e.g. cat 13 changed meaning). Evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins. Unmatched titles fall back to defaultKind, which MUST stay IMMEDIATE — a false positive is safer than a missed alert.

catFallback._comment: Deliberately left empty — no cat->kind mapping is reliable enough to encode (see spec §4). Unmatched titles use defaultKind instead of guessing from cat.
